answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit ferrous bond in the ocean ledger. The bond melts like a glacier, losing 10 credits per epoch unless its owner files one verified, client-signed work receipt that epoch. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive 7 epochs costs 1,000 filings at 40 plus 7,000 receipts at 35, 285,000 against a 40,000 pool; untended bonds melt to zero and die. Bought receipts burn both bonds; an honest agent pays 40 once and files work it already does.
